title: Aegis-Gate — WAF Overview
description: WAF traffic, decisions, latency and upstream health from OTLP traces (service.name=aegis-gate), plus per-node traffic + system (CPU/mem) panels. Generated by gen-waf-dashboard.py; edit panels freely in the UI. Per-node system panels need a per-node otel hostmetrics agent (deploy/otel/collector.yaml).

widgets.title: Total requests
widgets.description: All WAF decisions (waf.handle_data_request) in the window.

widgets.title: Request rate by action
widgets.description: WAF decisions per interval, split by action (allow / block / challenge / circuit_breaker / risk_reset).

widgets.title: Request latency (end-to-end · incl. upstream)
widgets.description: Full per-request span duration (waf.handle_data_request) — this WRAPS the upstream forward, so for allowed requests it's dominated by upstream RTT, not WAF decision cost. For the WAF's own cost see the next panel.

widgets.title: WAF decision latency (excl. upstream)
widgets.description: WAF's own decision cost: span duration of requests that did NOT forward upstream (action != allow — block/challenge/circuit_breaker), so the upstream RTT is excluded. This is the true sub-millisecond WAF overhead (matches the waf_overhead Prometheus stage).

widgets.title: Requests by tier
widgets.description: WAF decisions split by protection tier.

widgets.title: Top clients (peer)
widgets.description: Busiest client IPs seen by the data plane.

widgets.title: Upstream forward outcome
widgets.description: Outcome of upstream forwards (waf.forward_upstream), split by outcome.

widgets.title: Upstream forward latency (p95)
widgets.description: Upstream round-trip time (span duration of waf.forward_upstream), per upstream.

widgets.title: Request rate by node
widgets.description: WAF decisions per interval, split by node (resource host.name). One series per node in a multi-node cluster.

widgets.title: Blocked by node
widgets.description: Blocked requests (action=block) per interval, split by node.

widgets.title: Traffic share by node
widgets.description: Total WAF decisions per node over the window.

widgets.title: CPU load (1m) by node
widgets.description: System 1-minute load average per node (hostmetrics system.cpu.load_average.1m). Requires a per-node otel agent with the hostmetrics receiver (deploy/otel/collector.yaml).

widgets.title: Memory used by node
widgets.description: Used system memory per node (hostmetrics system.memory.usage, state=used). Requires a per-node otel agent with the hostmetrics receiver.
